title: Add schema edit functionality to SchemasPage
description:
SchemasPage has view and delete but no edit capability. Add ability to edit existing schemas.

**Implementation:**
- Add "Edit" button next to each schema row (or in SchemaViewer drawer)
- Reuse SchemaRegisterForm but pre-populate with existing schema data
- Submit as PUT to update endpoint
- Add mutation `useUpdateSchema()` in hooks
- On success: invalidate schemas query and close drawer

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/SchemasPage.tsx`, `dashboard/src/hooks/useSettings.ts` (or schema hooks)
definitionOfDone: Edit button visible for each schema

implementationPlan.description:
Update dashboard/src/pages/SchemasPage.tsx:
1. Add Edit button (Pencil icon) next to Delete button in each row's Actions cell. onClick: set `editSchemaId` state, fetch schema via `useSchema(editSchemaId)`, open Drawer.
2. Add `editSchemaId` state + edit Drawer that renders `SchemaRegisterForm` pre-populated with the fetched schema data (id as readonly, schema JSON pre-filled).
3. Since backend only has POST /schemas (upsert), the edit form submits via the same `useRegisterSchema()` mutation with the existing ID — this overwrites the schema. On success: close drawer, invalidate queries.
4. Import Pencil from lucide-react.
implementationPlan.note: Added Pencil edit button next to delete button in each row. Added editSchemaId state, useSchema fetch for edit data, and edit Drawer that renders SchemaRegisterForm with initialData prop.

implementationPlan.description: Update dashboard/src/components/schemas/SchemaRegisterForm.tsx (if it exists) to accept optional `initialData` prop for pre-populating fields in edit mode. If `initialData.id` is provided, make the ID field readonly. The form submit behavior stays the same (POST /schemas).
implementationPlan.note: Added initialData prop (id + body). In edit mode: ID field is readonly with visual cue, button says 'Update Schema', error message says 'update'. Uses same POST /schemas upsert endpoint.
